statements.markdown:
**Theorem A.1 (reciprocal-summable supports).** *Let $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}_{>0}$ be infinite. If*
$$
\sum_{a\in A}\frac1a<\infty,
$$
*then $X_A(b)$ is irrational for every integer $b\ge2$.*
